انتحرتن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَحَرْتُنَّ (intaḥartunna) /in.ta.ħar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# اُنْتُحِرْتُنَّ (untuḥirtunna) /un.tu.ħir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
